% Main LaTeX document for the SkillOS reproduction paper.

% Build:  bash scripts/build_paper.sh
% Output: docs/paper/build/main.pdf

% The markdown sources use Greek letters inline (lambda, beta) because that is
% how the reward equation reads in the original. pdflatex with inputenc cannot
% map them on its own, so declare them rather than mangling the sources.
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{03BB}{$\lambda$}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{03B2}{$\beta$}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{03B1}{$\alpha$}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{03BE}{$\xi$}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{00B1}{$\pm$}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{00D7}{$\times$}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{2264}{$\leq$}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{2265}{$\geq$}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{2212}{$-$}
\DeclareUnicodeCharacter{2248}{$\approx$}

% pandoc emits these for markdown constructs it cannot map directly.
\providecommand{\tightlist}{%
  \setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}}
\providecommand{\passthrough}[1]{#1}

% The markdown sources carry their own section numbers ("## 5.4 ...") because
% the prose cross-references them by hand while results are still moving. Let
% those stand as the single source of truth rather than having LaTeX number the
% headings a second time.
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{0}

\captionsetup{font=small,labelfont=bf}
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{5pt}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.15}

\title{\bf An Independent Reproduction of SkillOS\\
       with Contemporaneous Controls}

% disclosed rather than listed. Section 4.5 and Appendix A give the full division
% of labour; this is not a courtesy footnote.

  \small\itshape

}
